subject: Urgent: Latency & 5xx surge impacting LumosAI - request for makeup/credits and exec sync
messages:
From: Samir Patel <samir@lumos.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya@lumos.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 08:34:00 -0800
Subject: Production impact - 5xx/latency spike today (need remediation + credits)

Sean —

We started seeing a sustained latency increase and a 5xx spike this morning across our inference routes (predictable-workflow, batch-infer). Our throughput dropped ~35% during the window and several customer jobs timed out. This is causing downstream SLA violations on our side. Please provide:

- Immediate status (root cause if known)
- Expected timeline to full recovery
- A proposal for commercial makeup/credits for the impacted window (our contract references SLO-based credits)

Attaching some internal logs for your reference but we need a concrete remediation and a credit calculation we can show our execs. Priya and I are available for an exec-brief this afternoon if that helps.

Thanks,
Samir
Head of Platform Engineering, LumosAI
attachments: lumos-ops-logs-20270212.tar.gz (log bundle)
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@lumos.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production impact - 5xx/latency spike today (need remediation + credits)

Samir — thanks for the heads-up and the logs. We're on it. Quick summary of immediate actions from our side: 

- David's team is triaging the spike and isolating affected capacity pools.
- Monica (CS) will coordinate comms and an exec call if you want to escalate.
- I'll pull together an initial incident timeline and a preliminary credit calculation within 24 hours.

Can you confirm whether the impacted requests were routed to the hosted clusters in us-west-2 or your Dedicated pool? That helps us scope the root cause. We can do a 4:30pm PT executive sync today — ping me if that works.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
From: David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 12 Feb 2027 09:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Production impact - 5xx/latency spike today (need remediation + credits)

Adding technical notes from initial triage (brief):

- Timeline: spike began 2027-02-12T07:50:00Z, peaked ~08:20Z, partial recovery by ~09:05Z.
- Symptom: elevated p50/p95 latencies and increased transient 5xx from a subset of the gpt-custom-2 shards.
- Probable cause: contention due to a kernel update on a small fraction (~12%) of the serving fleet that degraded batching efficiency for long-sequence workloads.
- Mitigation in progress: rolling rollback and capacity reshuffle to compatible kernel/runtime profile; temporary auto-fallback to the gpt-custom-2-quant variant for latency-sensitive routes.

I'll prepare an attachment with the token-level SLO variance and a normalized throughput chart for your review. We need to finalize the impacted-window calculation before quantifying credits.

-David
SRE Manager, Serving Runtime
From: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@lumos.ai>, Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 15 Feb 2027 10:25:00 -0800
Subject: Proposal: Commercial makeup approach for LumosAI incident (attached)

Samir / Priya —

Thanks for your patience while we completed the initial technical analysis. Attached are two docs: a short SLO variance report that shows the impacted request classes and a proposed credit workbook with three remediation options. High-level recommendation:

Option A (fastest): 30% service credit for the impacted billing window + single-month account credit equivalent to 10% of monthly committed spend.
Option B (balanced): 20% service credit + targeted one-off usage credit for the affected routes proportional to lost successful request volume.
Option C (conservative): 10% service credit + ops investment (co-funded engineering hours) to perform workload tuning and a follow-up performance audit.

We can move forward with Option A to expedite resolution and get credits applied within two billing cycles, or select another option if you prefer a detailed throughput reconciliation. Doc references: slo-variance-report.pdf, proposed-credit-workback.xlsx (attached).

Also proposing a 30-minute exec sync Wed 2027-02-17 09:00 PT to finalize the commercial remedy and the timeline for any operational changes. Let me know if the slot works.

Best,
Vanessa Ortiz
VP, Commercial | Redwood Inference
attachments: slo-variance-report.pdf, proposed-credit-workback.xlsx
From: Priya Rao <priya@lumos.ai>
To: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Samir Patel <samir@lumos.ai>
Cc: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 17 Feb 2027 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Proposal: Commercial makeup approach for LumosAI incident (attached)

Vanessa / Sean —

Thanks for the clear options. LumosAI leadership prefers Option B (balanced) because we need an accurate throughput reconciliation for our downstream billing and partner commitments. We'll join the 09:00 PT sync, and Samir will bring our finance lead to validate the numbers.

A couple asks for the meeting:
- Please prepare the per-route loss calculation and the assumptions used to convert failed requests to credits.
- Share the HubSpot deal record you referenced so our finance folks can tie this to the original commit.

See you in the sync.

—Priya
From: Sean Gallagher <sean.gallagher@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <samir@lumos.ai>, Priya Rao <priya@lumos.ai>
Cc: Vanessa Ortiz <vanessa.ortiz@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, David Kim <david.kim@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 18 Feb 2027 16:10:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up & next steps (HubSpot link + timeline)

Thanks all — good sync today. Action items and commitments: 

1) Redwood will produce a per-route reconciliation spreadsheet (shared during the sync) that shows failed/successful counts, normalized throughput delta, and the proposed credit calculation for Option B. Deliverable ETA: 2027-02-19 17:00 PT.

2) Finance/commercial next steps: Vanessa will prepare the legal/contract amendment language to apply the credit and update the SLA clause. ETA: 2027-02-22.

3) Ops & SRE: David's team will complete the rollback and a follow-up performance audit (including quantization fallback verification). Ops postmortem shared by 2027-02-20.

4) Admin: I've uploaded the draft remediation proposal to the HubSpot deal record and a DocuSign envelope for the amendment. Links: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/deal/DEAL-2027-1147 and https://docusign.com/envelope/ABC-123-LUMOS.

If Lumos confirms Option B after reviewing the reconciliation on 2/19, we'll schedule the amendment and apply the credit in the next billing cycle. Closing note: appreciate the cooperative tone — we want to make this right.

—Sean
Director, Customer Success | Redwood Inference
